assay_targets_or_enrichments.ontology_label: Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

acquisition: Eluting peptides were analysed on an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer (ThermoFisher) using MS3 SPS with the settings recommended by the instrument manufacturer for TMT11 plex analysis.
labeling: Four microlitres of 22 g l−1 11-plex TMT tags (ThermoFisher A34808) were added to each sample.
TMT6plex was set as fixed modification.
quantification: quantification results of PSMs were combined into protein-level quantitation using MSstats TMT R package.
enrichment: we performed immunoprecipitation–mass spectrometry in WM3918 cells overexpressing CRKL with a V5 tag
Both conditions were immunoprecipitated using a V5 antibody (Invitrogen R960–25).
Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics
workflow_hints: Oxidation (M) was set as a variable modification
TMT6plex was set as fixed modification

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (immunoprecipitation) using TMT 11-plex labeling and MS3 SPS acquisition to mitigate ratio compression. The base workflow is DDA isobaric (TMT) with an AP-MS modifier.

scope: To characterize the protein complex formed by CRKL and identify its binding partners, we performed immunoprecipitation–mass spectrometry in WM3918 cells overexpressing CRKL with a V5 tag
Both conditions were immunoprecipitated using a V5 antibody (Invitrogen R960–25).

immunoprecipitation was performed in 2-ml deep well plates (Agilent 201379–100) using 1 mg of protein material and 5.75 μg V5 antibody (Invitrogen R960–25) bound to 5.75 μl Protein G Sepharose (Millipore Sigma 17–0618-02).

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically analyzed material captured via V5-antibody immunoprecipitation of CRKL-V5 complexes, not whole cell lysates.

While the broader study involves disease states (acral vs cutaneous melanoma) and zebrafish models, the mass spectrometry data provided in the PRIDE metadata and methods is restricted to this specific genetic overexpression contrast.
